meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会去查你在 cmem.ai 上保存的持久记忆(来自各 agent 的历史会话),先跑 1~3 轮宽泛关键词搜索,再按更精确的词缩小范围,最后用白话把相关记录讲给你听,你问「什么时候」时会带上时间戳。
howto.when: 当你提到 “search memory”、“mem search” 等关键词,或想了解某个项目、决定、文件、任务在过往会话里的上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的内容
say.note: 先宽泛搜索,再收窄,最后给结论

say.text: 上个会话我们都做了什么?
say.note: 会用白话总结,并带上时间戳

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 的状态
say.note: 显示 API key 是否已配置

howto.what_en: Claude searches your persistent Claude-Mem memory on cmem.ai: broad keyword searches first, then narrowed ones, then a plain-language answer with timestamps when you ask when.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "search memory", "mem search" and similar, or ask for prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search memory for anything about this project
say_en.note: Broad search, then narrowed, then a summary

say_en.text: What did we do last session?
say_en.note: Answered in plain language with timestamps
Shows whether the API key is configured
